answer: Require each identity to post a 900-unit bond and serve a 38-epoch probation. Each round it finishes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for eighteen rounds. The ledger checks signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm locks 900 units per alias and replays thirty-eight rounds, while a ridge of linked traces exposes the ring, ripple records anchor each review, and orchard assignments keep honest work varied.
